controls.label: Rate limit:
controls.tooltip: How long to wait between frequency updates sent to each TCI app. Changes made faster than this reach the app as the latest frequency once the time has passed. Off sends every change.

controls.label: CW becomes CWU above 10 MHz
controls.tooltip: On bands above 10 MHz, report mode as "CWU" instead of "CW" or "CWL". Required by certain logging apps that follow the ARRL sideband convention.

controls.label: Swap I/Q channels
controls.tooltip: Swap the I and Q samples in the TCI IQ data stream. Enabled by default for compatibility with most TCI IQ consumers.

controls.label: Always stream IQ
controls.tooltip: Stream IQ data to all connected TCI clients continuously, even if no client has explicitly subscribed to the IQ stream. Increases CPU and network load.

controls.label: Block size:
controls.tooltip: Number of audio samples per TCI audio stream block (100 to 2048). Larger blocks reduce overhead but increase latency.

controls.label: TX channel:
controls.tooltip: Which audio channel carries the TX audio in the TCI audio stream. "Both" sends the same mono signal to both left and right channels.

controls.label: RX interval:
controls.tooltip: How often RX sensor data (signal level, AGC gain, etc.) is pushed to TCI clients that subscribe to sensors (30 to 1000 ms).

controls.label: TX interval:
controls.tooltip: How often TX sensor data (forward power, SWR, ALC, etc.) is pushed to TCI clients that subscribe to sensors (30 to 1000 ms).

controls.label: Forget RX2 VFO B
controls.tooltip: While Duplicate RX2 VFO B to RX2 VFO A is on, send RX2's frequency to TCI apps only as RX2 VFO A, without its VFO B messages.

controls.label: Use RX1 VFO A for RX2 VFO A
controls.tooltip: While RX2 is on, TCI apps see RX1's frequency as RX2 VFO A, and an app that sets RX2 VFO A tunes RX1.

controls.label: Duplicate RX2 VFO B to RX2 VFO A
controls.tooltip: RX2 has one frequency, which TCI apps get as RX2 VFO B. This also sends it as RX2 VFO A, for apps that follow VFO A.

controls.label: Enable 4O3A integration
controls.tooltip: Gates the FlexAPI listener on TCP 4992 and the PGXL / TGXL auto-connect paths.  Off by default; turn on only when you want NereusSDR to expose itself to 4O3A amps and tuners on your local network.

controls.label: Status
controls.tooltip: The Core listens on TCP 4992. This window only shows the Core's status.

controls.label: Host IP
controls.tooltip: IP address or hostname of the Tuner Genius XL on your LAN. Leave blank to disable auto-connect.

controls.label: Port
controls.tooltip: TCP port the Tuner Genius XL listens on (default 9010).

controls.label: Connect
controls.tooltip: Connect to or disconnect from the Tuner Genius XL.

controls.label: Disconnect
controls.tooltip: Connect to or disconnect from the Tuner Genius XL.

controls.label: Host IP
controls.tooltip: IP address or hostname of the Power Genius XL on your LAN. Leave blank to disable auto-connect.

controls.label: Port
controls.tooltip: TCP port the Power Genius XL listens on (default 9008).

controls.label: Connect
controls.tooltip: Connect to or disconnect from the Power Genius XL.

controls.label: Disconnect
controls.tooltip: Connect to or disconnect from the Power Genius XL.

controls.label: Interlock Mode:
controls.tooltip:
Disabled: interlock never interferes with TX.
Warn: TX proceeds but a warning toast is shown when the amplifier
  is present but not in OPERATE (or SWR gate trips).
Block: TX is prevented when the amplifier is present but not in
  OPERATE (or SWR gate trips).
Default: Disabled.

controls.label: Grace Period:
controls.tooltip:
Grace period (ms) after the amplifier transitions to OPERATE before
the SWR gate is enforced. Ignores SWR spikes during PA warm-up so
the gate does not nuisance-trip on PSU current ramps. Timed from
the moment the amplifier enters OPERATE.
Range: 0..30000 ms.  Default: 3000 ms.

controls.label: Enable SWR Gate
controls.tooltip:
When enabled, a second interlock check fires if the current SWR
exceeds the Max SWR limit below. The Warn/Block action follows the
same Interlock Mode setting as the amplifier-state check.

controls.label: Max SWR:
controls.tooltip:
SWR ratio above which the gate triggers.
Only active when SWR Gate is enabled.
Range: 1.0..10.0.  Default: 3.0.

controls.label: TX Power Cap:
controls.tooltip: The Core shows an alert in every window when the Power Genius output goes above this.

controls.label: Apply Network Settings
controls.confirm: The Power Genius will switch to these network settings. If NereusSDR cannot reach it afterwards, enter its new address for the Power Genius on the Peripherals page and connect again.

controls.label: Auto-pair on connect
controls.tooltip: When enabled, NereusSDR pairs the Power Genius with the radio each time it connects. Turn this off only if the pairing is done some other way.

controls.label: Save & Reboot Amp
controls.confirm: Sending `save` will persist your configuration to flash and reboot the PGXL. The amplifier will be offline for approximately 20 seconds. NereusSDR will auto-reconnect when it returns. Do not transmit during reboot.

controls.confirm: The Tuner Genius will switch to these network settings. If NereusSDR cannot reach it afterwards, enter its new address for the Tuner Genius on the Peripherals page and connect again.

Save & Reboot Tuner
controls.confirm: Sending `save` will persist your configuration to flash and reboot the PGXL. The amplifier will be offline for approximately 20 seconds. NereusSDR will auto-reconnect when it returns. Do not transmit during reboot.

controls.label: Enable RF-Kit Amplifier integration
controls.tooltip: Gates the RF-Kit applet in the right-column panel and the RF2K-S configuration tab below.  Off by default; turn on only when an RF-Kit RF2K-S amplifier is connected.  Setting is scoped to the currently connected radio.

controls.label: Connect

controls.tooltip: Ask the Core to put the amplifier in TCI mode.
